scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n zola,ts,uno -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev" "pnpm dev:vite" "pnpm dev:unocss"
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:unocss && pnpm run build:subset-titlefont && pnpm run build:subset-bodyfont && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:rewrite-imgs && pnpm run build:short-links
scripts.build:subset-titlefont: cargo run --bin title-font-subset -- --content-dir content --font static/fonts/SourceHanSerifCN-VF.ttf --font-output-dir static/fonts --css-output-dir static/styles --css-file source-han-serif-cn-vf.css --font-family "Source Han Serif CN VF" --output-file source-han-serif-cn-vf.woff2
scripts.build:subset-bodyfont: cargo run --bin body-font-subset -- --content-dir content --config config.toml --font static/fonts/SourceHanSansSC-VF.ttf --base-css static/styles/source-han-sans-sc-vf.css --font-output-dir static/fonts --css-output-dir static/styles --css-file source-han-sans-sc-vf.patch.css --font-family "Source Han Sans SC VF" --output-file source-han-sans-sc-vf.patch.woff2
